name: compressor-reflex-mcp

tools.name: compress_tool_output
tools.description: Compress long tool outputs (file views, terminal logs, test failures, git diffs, directory trees) using the fine-tuned Compressor Reflex model. Preserves 100% of critical anchors, error traces, and targets while reducing tokens by up to 90%. Outputs <= 5 lines or <= 64 tokens are passed through verbatim.

text.description: The raw tool output text or terminal output to compress.

intent.description: Optional context or user intent explaining what the agent is searching for (e.g. 'check test failures in auth').

threshold.description: Extraction decision threshold tau (default: 0.50 calibrated). Range [0.0, 1.0].

tools.name: compress_file
tools.description: Reads a file from disk and compresses its contents using Compressor Reflex, keeping only relevant lines.

file_path.description: Path to the local file to read and compress.

intent.description: Optional query or task intent (e.g. 'find database connection settings').

tools.name: get_model_status
tools.description: Returns status of the Compressor Reflex ONNX model, Hugging Face Hub source, and cache path.
